title: Consultant, Professional Services
description:
**A Little About Us**
 EDB provides a data and AI platform that enables organizations to harness the full power of Postgres for transactional, analytical, and AI workloads across any cloud, anywhere. EDB empowers enterprises to control risk, manage costs and scale efficiently for a data and AI led world. Serving more than 1,500 customers globally and as the leading contributor to the vibrant and fast\-growing PostgreSQL community, EDB supports major government organizations, financial services, media and information technology companies. EDB’s data\-driven solutions enable customers to modernize legacy systems and break data silos while leveraging enterprise\-grade open source technologies. EDB delivers the confidence of up to 99\.999% high availability with mission critical capabilities built in such as security, compliance controls, and observability. For more information, visit www.enterprisedb.com
   

  

**Location:** 
 Navi Mumbai (WFO) \- Malad
   

  

 EDB is searching for a customer\-facing individual to provide EnterpriseDB PostgreSQL technical assistance to our customers both in\-person and virtually. This entails learning about their industry, formulating suggestions, providing Database deployment architecture, configuring/implementing database solutions. The ideal candidate is able to organize weak or ambiguously built client needs and turn them into successful customer interactions. This individual possesses a strong blend of people skills and in\-depth understanding of database deployments. Technical skills are as vital as written and vocal communication skills. This individual will not only provide technical services to customers but also collaborate with our product engineering teams to establish the future direction of our products and provide input to sales and sales engineering regarding new business opportunities. This job can include some moderate travel.
   

  

**What Your Impact Will Be**
* Assess the existing deployments of Postgres, associated tools in the customer place, and make recommendations on how to improve them and document the required technical steps.
* Gather and record the enterprise\-wide database requirements by consulting with the stakeholders in the client teams.
* Work on creating proposals for professional services that meet the objectives and goals of customers.
* Possessing knowledge of programming languages like C/C\+\+, PHP, python, Java or Ruby to guide customers in the development of custom Postgres\-based applications.
* Troubleshooting the various Database challenges including the performance issues
* Perform database Migrations from Oracle, SQL Server, and / or MySQL to PostgreSQL
* Performance tuning for existing database deployments
* Work with customers to upgrade their application to the latest version of Postgres and configure / change their application to take advantage of new features.
* Design and implement Database High Availability configurations using PostgreSQL.
* Evaluate security needs by customers and make recommendations.
* Document all work clearly and concisely in runbooks and customer communications throughout the project.
* Implement backup strategies and perform upgrades and patching.
* Develop Data migration strategies to migrate large databases in line with the customer downtime constraints.
* Implement advanced Database monitoring and set up the alerts using the industry best practices and tools.


**What You Will Bring**
* 10\+ years of working experience for a professional consulting organization in the Database area with strong Database foundation skills.
* 6\+ years of direct working experience on PostgreSQL and Oracle databases
* Expertise in PostgreSQL Database implementation for high availability in large enterprise environments.
* Be familiar with database design and building applications for PostgreSQL, Oracle, or other databases.
* Expert knowledge on General system administration and performance tuning skills for Linux (Ubuntu, Centos, Red hat, or Debian), including troubleshooting and scripting.
* Be well\-versed in SQL and MS Windows
* Have strong time management skills, and the ability to balance multiple projects in parallel.
* Have a bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science / Engineering or equivalent experience
* Able to travel about 30 \- 40%
* Have strong written and verbal communication skills
* Excellent troubleshooting skills


**What Will Give You An Edge**
* Proficient with PostgreSQL community version and EDB’s PostgreSQL
* Proficient with EDB tools
* Proficient with database tuning and use of PostgreSQL tools such as PgBadger, PEM, BARMAN
* Proficient with PostgreSQL replication technologies Streaming, Logical and Bidirectional
* Proficient with PostgreSQL architecture
* Proficient with PostgreSQL networking, HBA and connection pooling (PgBouncer, PgPool)
* Working knowledge of OLTP/DSS/DW system design
* Working knowledge of scripting languages, BASH, KSH, Python, Perl etc.
* Have experience deploying open\-source software.
* Working with virtual teams and from remote office locations


 EDB is committed to supporting our employees' overall well being by offering a range of benefits and resources to promote a healthy work\-life balance and wellness. We provide access to CuraLinc to aid employees in health and wellness tips and practices, as well as Wellness Fridays extending to December 2026! Check out our career site for more information on perks and benefits and reach out to our Talent Acquisition team for region specific benefits.
   

  

 We know it takes a unique mix of people and skills to help us in our mission to supercharge Postgres, and we understand that not everyone will check every box. We’d love to hear from you and we want you to apply!
   

  

 EDB is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. EDB was built on a commitment to trust and respect each other and to embrace an array of people and ideas. These values remain at the center of our culture and are key to our company’s integrity.
   

  

 EDB does not seek or accept unsolicited resumes or CVs from recruitment agencies. EDB and its affiliates are not responsible for, and will not pay, any fees, commissions, or any other similar payment related to unsolicited resumes or CVs except as required in a written signed agreement between EDB and the recruitment agency or party requesting payment of a fee.

**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Manager, Tax Services** 
**– Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) \- SAP FICO/MM/SD integration with Direct or Indirect Tax experience**
 You will lead and support SAP\-enabled tax transformation efforts for US\-based clients, helping organizations improve the way tax integrates with enterprise processes and technology. As part of Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited, this role sits at the intersection of tax, ERP, and business transformation, with a focus on direct and indirect tax integration across SAP FICO, MM, and SD. You will work with client stakeholders, lead teams, and help deliver implementation\-driven solutions in a complex global tax environment.
   

  

**Work you'll do**
 As a Manager, Tax Services on the Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) team, you will be responsible for:
   

  

* Business Development: Develop and maintain contact with top decision makers at key clients; organize and lead pursuit teams; participate and lead aspects of the proposal development process; contribute to the development of proposal pricing strategies.
* Client Management: Manage the day\-to\-day interactions with executive clients and sponsors.
* Engagement Management: Lead engagement planning and budgeting; mobilize and manage engagement teams; define deliverable structure and content; facilitate buy\-in of proposed solutions from top management levels at the client; direct on\-time, quality delivery of work products; manage engagement economics; and manage engagement risk.
* Practice Development \& Eminence: Develop practical solutions and methodologies; develop "thought\-ware" and "point\-of\-view" documents; participate in public speaking events; get published in industry periodicals.
* People Development: Perform role of counselor and coach; provide input and guidance into the staffing process; actively participate in staff recruitment and retention activities; provide leadership and support for delivery teams and staff in local offices.


**The team**
 Deloitte’s Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) group helps our clients’ tax departments improve their operations by developing new technology\-enabled, cutting\-edge methods and processes. Deloitte TTC professionals are aligned across our global network of member firms to address our clients’ objectives in a seamless fashion. Deloitte TTC teams include industry, tax, organizational change, technology, and co\-sourcing specialists who help connect our clients’ global strategies and the options that exist to turn theory into an executable plan.
   

  

 TTC’s Enterprise Tax Integration (ETI) professionals provide an integrated approach to process improvement that can help the tax department maximize its strategic value to the organization. Companies that have already implemented or are considering implementing an enterprise resource planning (ERP) system often overlook the tax benefits these systems can provide or underestimate the impact on the tax department. To be most effective from a tax perspective, a successful ERP implementation requires professionals who specialize in tax and can effectively address a corporate tax function’s unique needs, requirements, and obligations. Our ETI team, the largest of its type, offers the necessary combination of skills, methodology and practical experience to help clients avoid the pitfalls of an ERP implementation.
   

  

 Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) \- Ever expanding regulations and increasing scrutiny on multinational corporations has made it necessary for leading\-edge tax departments to serve a critical role in the risk management and overall performance of the enterprise. This has resulted in an opportunity for Deloitte to provide even greater value through our tax services, in helping develop tax departments of the future that are strategic, agile, and, above all, focused on creating value for the business.
   

  

 Deloitte's TTC group helps our clients’ tax department move forward from their current state to the next generation of tax functions and is dedicated to finding new methods and processes to assist clients in improving their tax operations. Deloitte Tax LLP professionals are aligned worldwide to serve our clients’ needs through the TTC group. Deloitte TTC teams include industry, tax, organizational change, technology, and co\-sourcing specialists who can help make the necessary connections between our clients’ global strategies and the many options for carrying them out in the tax function.
   

  

**Location: Bengaluru, Chennai, Gurugram, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Mumbai, Pune**
**Qualifications**
 Required:
   

  

* 8 to 15\+ years of total experience.
* 5\+ years of Implementation experience in SAP ECC 6\.0 \& S4 HANA with focus on Tax integration with SAP FICO/MM/SD integration with direct or indirect tax experience.
* Experience with tax technology applications i.e., ONESOURCE /Global NEXT Integration, Vertex/Accelerator \& Chain flow Accelerator Integration, Avalara, Sovos.
* Expert in Direct and Indirect Tax configuration, Withholding Taxes, local country indirect tax localizations, VAT customizations and Reporting.
* Experience with User Exits, preparing functional specifications, executing test cycles, cutovers, go\-live and Hypercare, providing user training and documentation.
* Expert in cross functional integration of modules \- SD\-FI \& MM\-FI
* Strong analytical skills in business process design and requirements preparation


 Preferred:
   

  

* SAP MM or SD (ECC or S4 HANA) Certified
* SAP DRC, Central Finance with Tax integration, Transfer Pricing, BRIM
* Experience with New GL, Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, Intercompany, Materials Management, Logistics Invoice Verification, Asset Accounting implementation.
* Experience with Ariba, Coupa, Hybris, Open Text, Read soft Integration with ERP.


 \#SAPFICO\-TTC
   

  

**Our purpose**
 Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
   

  

**Our people and culture**
 Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
   

  

**Professional development**
 At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state\-of\-the\-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
   

  

**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
 At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
   

  

**Recruiting tips**
 From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

 B.E / B.Tech \+ MBA (Marketing) from reputed institutes

 7\+ years’ work experience, preferably in Business / Market Development roles in technology differentiated B2B environments.
   

  

 Strong consultative selling background, with proven customer engagement and acquisition experience.

 Negotiation skills: Can negotiate skilfully in tough situations, with both internal and external groups, can win concessions without damaging relationships, gains trust quickly of other parties in negotiations, able to close deals.

title: Technical Service Manager (TSM) - Maritime, Mumbai
description:
**About Us**
 We are the independent expert in assurance and risk management. Driven by our purpose, to safeguard life, property, and the environment, we empower our customers and their stakeholders with facts and reliable insights so that critical decisions can be made with confidence.
   

  

 As a trusted voice for many of the world’s most successful organizations, we use our knowledge to advance safety and performance, set industry benchmarks, and inspire and invent solutions to tackle global transformations.
   

  

**About Maritime**
 We help enhance the safety, efficiency, and sustainability of our customers in the global shipping industry, covering all vessel types and mobile offshore units. As a partner to industry, we offer services in testing, certification, training, and technical advisory through the energy value chain. That means we’re continually investing heavily into R\&D for new services and solutions while proactively assessing what the industry needs today and tomorrow.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Be the primary liaison for assigned Key Accounts on technical and operational matters which cannot be solved neither by DATE, nor by the Operational Centres or the surveyor network. Help the assigned Key Accounts maintain smooth technical operations and continuous vessel trade by providing personal attention, outstanding competence and added value in identifying, solving and advising the customer on those technical and operational issues in alignment with DNV’s purpose, business objectives and principles.
   

  

 The result is that you maintain and develop a trustful win\-win relationship and contribute to high customer satisfaction and loyalty which build an important foundation for DNV to maintain a high quality fleet, successfully retain existing business and secure new business.
   

  

 Team up with the relevant Key Account Manager (KAM) and work collaboratively with the Account Team and all relevant departments within DNV to ensure that excellent technical customer service levels are delivered.
   

  

 Be an important part of the Key Account Planning and Implementation process to help the KAM prepare and execute a high\-impact Key Account Plan, Account Strategy and Actions that adds value to the customer and to DNV. Provide input to the KAM on the Key Account\`s technical needs and expectations, relevant technology and regulatory developments, suitable strategies and actions related to the Key Account\`s technical issues and technical operations. Help implement the assigned actions according to plan.
   

  

 Develop and strengthen the customer relationship, operating at the Key Account\`s technical department and technical management levels, to achieve preferred supplier status based on lasting personal relationships and the added value delivered.
   

  

 Solve and advise on operational requests, customer technical concerns and technical complaints related to survey and audit performance in close collaboration with relevant technical experts and the KAM to ensure continuous vessel trade. Hand over customer requests to DATE or Operations Centres in case the requests fall into the service scope of those units.
   

  

 Systematically identify any major technical and technical operation challenges and technical concerns related to the DNV interaction with the Key Account and cascade to the KAM and to relevant departments within DNV. Follow\-up with the findings and ensure that related improvement activities are executed under utilization of the relevant DNV organization.
   

  

 Bring in foresight and help spot and resolve potential technical problems before they occur.
   

  

 Consult the customer on technical matters in meetings, presentations and workshops together or in alignment with the KAM and relevant stakeholders within DNV .
   

  

 Train, guide and consult the Key Account on rules and regulations as well as on new tools and new work processes to help them leverage the full value of our solutions and to facilitate customer's planning and implementation into operations.
   

  

 Measure and monitor the Key Account\`s performance on critical technical key performance indicators, address and support improving performance gaps by developing adequate plans and actions in alignment with the KAM and the relevant DNV organization as well as the Key Account.
   

  

 While your focus is on technical issues, remain attentive towards identifying potential business opportunities and hand those over to the KAM.
   

  

 Pro\-actively stay up to date with relevant industry, regulatory and technology trends and best practices as well as with the relevant DNV products, services, processes and tools to remain relevant towards the Key Accounts.
   

  

 Liaise with Indian flag for Flag related matters.
   

  

 Experience working with MOU’s is an added advantage.
   

  

 What we offer
   

  

* Flexible work arrangements for better work\-life balance
* Generous Paid Leaves (Annual, Sick, Compassionate, Local Public, Marriage, Maternity, Paternity, Medical leave)
* Medical benefits ( Insurance and Annual Health Check\-up)
* Pension and Insurance Policies (Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance, Travel Insurance)
* Training and Development Assistance (Training Sponsorship, On\-The\-Job Training, Training Programme)
* Additional Benefits (Long Service Awards, Mobile Phone Reimbursement)
* Company bonus/Profit share.


 DNV is an Equal Opportunity Employer and gives consideration for employment to qualified applicants without regard to gender, religion, race, national or ethnic origin, cultural background, social group, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age or political opinion. Diversity is fundamental to our culture and we invite you to be part of this diversity.
   

  

**About You**
* Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in the maritime/offshore industry, with exposure to ship and MOU operations, classification requirements, and customer\-facing roles.
* Driven, goal\-oriented, and results\-focused professional with a proactive approach to achieving business objectives.
* Strong team player with the ability to collaborate effectively across functions and stakeholders.
* Capable of performing efficiently under pressure while maintaining high standards of quality and performance.
* Forward\-thinking, innovative, and solution\-oriented, with strong analytical, decision\-making, and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent customer engagement and relationship management abilities, with a proven capability to interact effectively at both operational and executive levels.
* Possesses strong knowledge of the maritime industry, offshore operations, and classification requirements.
* Experienced in ship and Mobile Offshore Unit (MOU) operations, enabling effective communication and engagement with a diverse customer base.
* Skilled in working closely with Area Managers, Approval Centre Managers, Production Managers, Business Development Managers, and Key Account Managers (KAMs) to achieve organizational goals.
* Fluent in English, both written and spoken, with excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
* International exposure and experience working with multicultural teams and stakeholders are considered a strong advantage.
* Self\-motivated and comfortable working autonomously, demonstrating leadership, ownership, and accountability.
* Willing and able to travel as required by the role.


 Security and compliance with statutory requirements in the countries in which we operate is essential for DNV. Background checks will be conducted on all final candidates as part of the offer process, in accordance with applicable country\-specific laws and practices.

title: Leasing Manager
description:
Role Description:
 



  





 Development and execution of business development strategies,
 **industrial leasing** 
 focused on both direct interactions with end\-clients and indirect sales channels (via IPCs and brokers) in the focused region, aimed at establishing strong and long\-lasting relationships with clients and channel partners.
 



 From traditional big\-box facilities to mega\-infra port\-based assets catering to global clients, and future\-ready mixed\-use developments that redefine urban last\-mile distribution, we are building new\-age assets that ensure seamless connectivity between businesses to consumers, we are redefining the future of logistics. Welspun One solves the locational needs of businesses by building best in class and innovative new age
 **Real Estate** 
 solutions.
 



  





**Key responsibilities:** 




 Business Development Strategy:
 


* Formulate business development plan annually (with semi\-annual targets) in close collaboration with National Head \- Leasing.
* Collaborate with leasing support and investment teams to identify potential sectors and micro markets, product development (Mix\-Use, In\-City, etc), competitor client lease expirations, and new land purchase developments to develop a targeted BD strategy.



  





 Client identification and lead generation:
 


* Identify potential customers and regularly maintain target tracker.
* Attend industry events, conferences, and trade shows to network and promote the company's services.
* Present, promote and effectively communicate company’s offerings and value proposition to prospective clients to ensure deal conversion for under construction assets by establishing a healthy active pipeline (account hunting)
* Monitor lease expiration date of existing clients \& discuss renewal options.
* Periodically review client accounts to identify areas of growth (tenant improvement/expansions) and implement strategies to maximize revenue (account farming).
* Establish and manage relationships with region focused IPCs and local brokers to capture key accounts and develop cohesive understanding of market trends.



  





 Lead Management:
 


* Periodic review of lead tracker to continually track open leads and ensure adherence towards defined follow\-up cadence.
* Maintain lead tracker on CRM platform (Zoho) for real time view of leads.



  





 Deal Qualification:
 


* Discussion of broad leasing terms (e.g., specifications, layout, etc.) with prospective clients to obtain alignment.
* Responsible for techno\-commercial discussions/ negotiations (rental rates, costing, technical requirements, etc.) to ensure deal closure at/ above IRR targets.
* Co\-ordination with prospective clients and internal teams for site visits.
* Prepare client proposals with adherence to org. policies and standards.
* Coordinate and obtain sign\-off from all internal stakeholders (projects, finance, CCO, etc.) prior to proposal submission.



  





 Transaction:
 


* Ensure all leasing documentation is accurate, complete, and compliant with company policies and legal requirements.
* Manage the lease renewal process, including negotiating terms with existing tenants and preparing renewal agreements.



  





 Key account management:
 


* Act as the Key Account Manager across project lifecycle.
* Responsible for query resolution and providing appropriate solutions to ensure customer delight (till LOI stage).
* Oversee delivery of customer satisfaction by leasing operations team from LOI to tenancy stage and facility management teams during tenancy stage; responsibility to step\-in during client escalations.



  





 MIS and reporting:
 


* Ensure effective trail management of target client list, deal movement, active pipeline records, etc. on CRM platform (Zoho).
* Provision of regular reports and updates on sales activities, client interactions, market trends, competition mapping \& their recent deal closure to senior management.



  





**Work Experience Requirements:** 



* Proven experience in business development, client management, and sales via IPCs and local brokers within the real estate sector or related industries. Good to have knowledge of the warehouse real estate sector, including market dynamics, key players, and investment trends. Experience in establishing and maintaining a network of IPCs and local brokers.
* **Target Companies:** 
 Real estate team of e\-commerce/3PL players, International Property consultants (IPC), industrial or warehousing real estate developer.

title: Business Continuity Manager @ Mumbai
description:
We are seeking a knowledgeable and client\-focused
 **Cybersecurity GRC Consultant** 
 to support consulting, assessment, audit, compliance, and documentation engagements across information security, privacy, regulatory compliance, third\-party risk, and cyber resilience. The ideal candidate will have hands\-on experience delivering cybersecurity GRC engagements for clients, interpreting regulatory requirements, conducting maturity and posture assessments, and preparing high\-quality client\-facing reports, policies, and remediation roadmaps.
 



**Role Overview** 




 The Cybersecurity GRC Consultant will work with clients across industries to assess, design, implement, and improve cybersecurity governance, risk, compliance, privacy, and resilience programs. The role requires strong consulting capability, audit experience, stakeholder management skills, and the ability to translate technical and regulatory requirements into actionable business controls.
 



 The consultant will contribute to engagements involving ISO standards, NIST\-based assessments, Indian financial\-sector regulations, privacy compliance, third\-party risk management, cyber risk assessment, policy development, awareness programs, and audit readiness.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Conduct cybersecurity GRC consulting, assessment, audit, and advisory engagements for client organizations.
* Perform ISO/IEC 27001:2022 ISMS gap assessments, internal audits, implementation support, risk assessments, control reviews, and certification\-readiness activities.
* Support business continuity and resilience engagements aligned with ISO 22301, including BCMS documentation, business impact analysis, risk assessment, continuity planning, and exercise support.
* Conduct cybersecurity posture assessments, maturity assessments, control effectiveness reviews, and compliance gap assessments.
* Assess client environments against relevant frameworks and standards, including:
* ISO/IEC 27001:2022
* NIST Cybersecurity Framework and related NIST guidance
* SOC 2 Type II requirements
* Data Protection and Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (DPDPA) requirements
* General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR)
* Data privacy principles, privacy governance, and privacy\-by\-design requirements
* RBI cybersecurity, IT governance, outsourcing, digital\-payment, and related regulatory requirements
* SEBI cybersecurity and cyber\-resilience requirements
* IRDAI cybersecurity, information security, and related regulatory requirements
* Lead or support cyber risk management activities, including risk identification, control mapping, risk scoring, treatment planning, risk\-register maintenance, and management reporting.
* Conduct Third\-Party Risk Management (TPRM) assessments, including vendor due diligence, cybersecurity questionnaires, risk evaluation, contractual security requirements, and remediation tracking.
* Support SOC 2 Type II readiness reviews, control design assessments, evidence reviews, and ongoing compliance monitoring.
* Develop, review, and enhance cybersecurity policies, standards, procedures, guidelines, frameworks, registers, and process documentation.
* Prepare client deliverables such as assessment reports, audit reports, gap\-analysis reports, compliance matrices, risk registers, remediation roadmaps, executive presentations, and management dashboards.
* Conduct cybersecurity awareness and training programs for employees, management, and relevant stakeholders.
* Facilitate client workshops, interviews, walkthroughs, evidence reviews, risk discussions, and leadership presentations.
* Track observations, nonconformities, risks, action plans, and closure evidence through the engagement lifecycle.
* Collaborate with technical, legal, privacy, business, audit, and compliance stakeholders to ensure practical implementation of cybersecurity controls.
* Keep abreast of evolving cybersecurity regulations, privacy requirements, threat trends, and industry best practices.
* Contribute to proposal development, scoping, pre\-sales discussions, statements of work, and client presentations where required.



**Required Experience and Skills** 



* 5–6 years of relevant experience in cybersecurity GRC consulting, information security consulting, IT audit, risk advisory, compliance, or related roles.
* Demonstrated experience working directly with clients in a consulting, advisory, audit, or assurance capacity.
* Hands\-on experience in ISO/IEC 27001 implementation, gap assessment, internal audit, risk assessment, control documentation, or certification\-readiness engagements.
* Strong understanding of NIST cybersecurity frameworks and their practical application in assessment and improvement programs.
* Working knowledge of DPDPA, GDPR, data privacy governance, data lifecycle controls, consent management concepts, data\-subject rights, and privacy risk assessments.
* Experience with RBI, SEBI, and IRDAI cybersecurity and regulatory expectations; experience supporting BFSI clients will be preferred.
* Experience in Third\-Party Risk Management, including vendor security assessments, supplier due diligence, risk classification, and remediation follow\-up.
* Experience in cybersecurity posture assessments, cyber maturity assessments, cyber risk assessments, and compliance gap assessments.
* Familiarity with SOC 2 Type II requirements, Trust Services Criteria, control mapping, audit evidence, and readiness activities.
* Strong capability in developing and reviewing cybersecurity policies, standards, procedures, risk registers, control matrices, and compliance documentation.
* Experience in conducting cybersecurity training and awareness initiatives.
* Ability to interpret regulatory and framework requirements and translate them into practical, measurable, client\-specific controls.
* Strong report\-writing, documentation, presentation, stakeholder\-management, and client communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent engagements, meet project timelines, and work independently with limited supervision.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and documentation/reporting tools.



**Mandatory Certifications** 




 Candidates must hold the following valid certifications:
 


* **ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Lead Auditor**
* **ISO 22301 Lead Auditor**
* **Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA)**



**Good\-to\-Have Certifications** 




 The following certifications will be an added advantage:
 


* Certified Information Security Manager (CISM)
* ISO/IEC 42001 Lead Auditor
* Other relevant certifications in privacy, risk management, cloud security, SOC, or business continuity

title: Founder office
description:
About the role
 



  





 This is a high\-ownership seat next to the founder of a fast\-growing AI marketing company working in Generative Engine Optimisation — the discipline of making brands the answer that AI engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Claude give when people ask a question.
 



  





 The category is roughly three years old. We work with listed companies, hospitals, defence manufacturers, luxury houses, law firms and global consumer brands across India, the US and Southeast Asia. There is no established playbook, which is exactly what makes this interesting.
 



  





 You will not have a narrow job description. You'll work on whatever is most important that week — which could be a client proposal on Monday, a hiring process on Wednesday and a pricing model on Friday.
 



  





 What you'll actually do
 



  





 • Client strategy and proposals — research prospects, build audits and scope documents, and prepare the commercial proposals the founder takes into rooms
 



 • Business development support — prepare for pitches, handle follow\-ups, and manage the pipeline so nothing goes cold
 



 • Special projects — new product definition, market research, partnership evaluation, pricing structures
 



 • Internal systems — help build the processes, templates and trackers that let delivery scale without breaking
 



 • Hiring and team building — draft roles, screen candidates, run first\-round conversations
 



 • Meeting follow\-through — capture what was decided, convert it into actions, and make sure those actions actually close
 



 • Anything else that needs an owner — genuinely
 



  





 What we're looking for
 



  





 • 2–5 years of experience — consulting, investment banking, startup operations, strategy, or a founder's office elsewhere. Strong recent graduates from top institutions with real internship depth will also be considered
 



 • Exceptional written English. You will write a great deal — proposals, emails, documents that go to CXOs of large companies
 



 • Structured thinking. You can take something ambiguous and turn it into a clear plan
 



 • Genuine research ability. You check facts, notice when two sources disagree, and don't assume
 



 • Comfort with ambiguity and pace. Priorities shift; you need to be the kind of person who finds that energising rather than destabilising
 



 • Real ownership instinct. Nobody will chase you. Things you own should close
 



  





 What will make you stand out
 



  





 • Hands\-on familiarity with AI tools as working instruments, not novelties
 



 • Exposure to B2B sales, agency or consulting environments
 



 • Financial literacy — you can build a pricing model or read a company's results
 



 • Experience working directly with senior leadership
 



  





 What this job is not
 



  





 • It is not a coordination or note\-taking role. You'll be expected to have views and defend them
 



 • It is not narrowly defined. If you need a fixed remit to do your best work, this will frustrate you
 



 • It is not a comfortable 10\-to\-6\. The pace is real, and so is the learning
 



  





 Why take it
 



  





 You'll sit at the centre of a company in a category that barely exists yet, with unusual visibility into how clients are won, priced and kept. The exposure is far broader than an equivalent\-level role at a larger firm — you'll see the whole business rather than one function of it.
 



  





 For the right person, this is a role that compounds quickly.
 



  





 To apply: send your CV and a short note — no more than half a page — on something you owned end\-to\-end and what you'd do differently, to abhay@connectify.global

title: Founders office
description:
Founder’s Office – Strategy, Business Development \& Operations

 KS Legal is looking for a highly driven, sharp and entrepreneurial individual to work directly with the Founder as part of the Founder’s Office.
 



  





 This is not a conventional desk job. We are looking for someone who can operate as an extension of the Founder someone who can think independently, manage people, build relationships, drive business, represent the firm professionally and take ownership of whatever needs to get done.
 



  





 The role will involve working across strategy, operations, client management, business development, PR, networking, presentations, research and special projects.
 



  





 You should be comfortable moving between a client meeting, a team discussion, a pitch presentation, a networking event and an internal operational issue and be able to handle each with confidence.
 



  





 What You Will Do
 



  





 1\. Founder’s Office \& Execution
 



  





 \* Work closely with the Founder on day\-to\-day strategic and operational priorities.
 



 \* Convert the Founder’s ideas and discussions into actionable tasks and ensure timely execution.
 



 \* Follow up with internal teams, clients, external stakeholders and vendors.
 



 \* Manage multiple priorities simultaneously and ensure nothing falls through the cracks.
 



 \* Identify problems independently and find solutions rather than waiting for instructions.
 



 \* Prepare briefs, reports, trackers, presentations and updates for the Founder.
 



 \* Assist with special projects and initiatives undertaken by the firm.
 



  





 2\. Team Management
 



  





 \* Coordinate and manage different teams and workstreams.
 



 \* Allocate and follow up on tasks and monitor timelines.
 



 \* Ensure accountability and execution across the team.
 



 \* Identify bottlenecks and escalate important issues to the Founder.
 



 \* Help create systems, processes and workflows to improve the firm’s efficiency.
 



 \* Maintain discipline around deadlines, deliverables and follow\-ups.
 



  





 3\. Business Development \& Client Acquisition
 



  





 \* Identify and develop potential clients and business opportunities.
 



 \* Build and maintain relationships with founders, promoters, CXOs, investors, professionals, companies and other relevant stakeholders.
 



 \* Assist in converting relationships and conversations into mandates.
 



 \* Research prospective clients and understand their business and legal requirements.
 



 \* Participate in client meetings and business discussions.
 



 \* Prepare pitches, proposals, credentials and presentations.
 



 \* Follow up on leads, proposals and prospective mandates.
 



 \* Develop new channels for business generation and strategic partnerships.
 



 \* Represent KS Legal at networking events, conferences and industry forums.
 



  





 4\. Client Relationship Management
 



  





 \* Maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective clients.
 



 \* Understand client requirements and coordinate internally to ensure effective delivery.
 



 \* Track important client conversations, follow\-ups and opportunities.
 



 \* Ensure a high\-quality client experience.
 



 \* Identify opportunities to expand existing client relationships.
 



  





 5\. PR, Media \& Brand Building
 



  





 \* Work with the Founder and external/internal PR teams on the firm’s positioning and visibility.

 \* Assist with journalist outreach and PR pitching.
 



 \* Coordinate thought\-leadership opportunities for the Founder and the firm.
 



 \* Help develop content, presentations, articles, opinions and other external communications.
 



 \* Track relevant industry conversations and identify opportunities for KS Legal to participate.
 



  





 6\. Presentations \& Communication
 



  





 \* Create high\-quality presentations, pitch decks, business proposals and internal presentations.
 



 \* Assist the Founder in preparing for important meetings, pitches and speaking engagements.
 



 \* Develop clear and compelling written and verbal communication for clients and external stakeholders.
 



 \* Present confidently when required.
 



  





 7\. Research \& Strategic Projects
 



  





 \* Conduct business, industry, competitor and market research.
 



 \* Track developments relevant to the firm’s practice areas and clients.
 



 \* Identify new sectors, industries and opportunities for the firm.
 



 \* Assist in developing new practice areas, initiatives and business strategies.
 



 \* Prepare concise research notes and actionable insights for the Founder.
 



  





 8\. Travel \& External Representation
 



  





 \* Travel with the Founder or independently for client meetings, conferences, networking events and business development initiatives, as required.
 



 \* Represent KS Legal professionally in meetings and external events.
 



 \* Coordinate logistics and preparation for meetings, events and travel.
 



  





 What We Are Looking For
 



  





 We are looking for an owner, not an order\-taker.
 



  





 The ideal candidate will be:
 



  





 \* Highly proactive and self\-driven.
 



 \* Extremely organised and excellent at follow\-ups.
 



 \* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced and demanding environment.
 



 \* Strong in communication, presentation and relationship\-building.
 



 \* Commercially aware and interested in business development.

title: Government & Partnership Associate, iTeach Growth Team
description:
**Why do we exist? What do we do?** 




 The quality of school education available to low\-income students across India is abysmal — it decides, before they've had a real shot, whether they'll ever attend college or build a career. iTeach Schools was born in 2015 to break that pattern and build a level playing field for every child.
 



 We run free, high\-impact schools and a college\-to\-career program for the most disadvantaged students in Pune and Navi Mumbai, known for world\-class professional development, a results\-driven culture, and student\-centric school design. More at
 
 www.iTeachSchools.org
 
 .
 



  





**Role Summary** 




 iTeach is scaling fast — from 4,500 to 10,000\+ students over the next 5 years, through 10\-12 new schools across Maharashtra's Municipal Corporations. This role sits within our Growth team and is where that growth gets built on the ground: identifying new opportunities, gathering the data that shapes our expansion decisions, and keeping our government stakeholder relationships strong.
 



 There are three key parts of the Government Partnerships \& Expansion Associate role.
 



  





**A. Expansion Work** 



* Support on\-ground landscape studies in current and prospective Municipal Corporations — finding space, infrastructure availability, and educational gaps.
* Conduct field visits and gather ground\-level data to inform which municipal corporation iTeach expands to next.
* Help identify and open initial conversations with local stakeholders and influential contacts in new areas.
* Support proposal and tender documentation as new Municipal Corporation opportunities move forward.



  





**B. Stakeholder Engagement \& Liaisoning** 



* Identify, build, and maintain relationships with key stakeholders — administrative (Municipal Corporation, Education Department, Zilla Parishad, State Government, SSC Board, Sarva Shiksha Abhiyaan) and political (Corporators, local leaders, community influencers).
* Serve as the day\-to\-day point of contact between iTeach Schools and government stakeholders, regarding everything related to expansion proposals.
* Resolve issues between government officers and iTeach Schools.
* Keep the team updated on relevant policy and procedural changes.



  





**C. Compliance \& Systemic Reform** 



* Secure all necessary permissions and compliances for new schools from relevant departments.



  





**Education and Competencies** 



* Required: Graduate or above.
* Required: Minimum 2 years of experience in social sector work.
* Mandatory: Prior experience working with the government, or exposure to public field\-based work.
* Mandatory: Proficiency in reading, writing, and typing in Marathi and English.



  





**Location** 



* Mumbai based. Willing and able to travel within Greater Mumbai and occasionally other Municipal Corporations with prospective expansion opportunities.



  





**Compensation and Benefits:** 
 We take pride in offering competitive compensation and benefits commensurate with the candidate's education and work experience. The salary range for this position ranges from 4\.32 \- 5\.28 LPA CTC, and we are dedicated to providing top\-notch industry benefits. These benefits include PF, gratuity, medical insurance (up to 3 lakh PA), paid leaves, annual increments, and promotion opportunities.

title: Logistics Professional
description:
**Freight Forwarding \& LCL Consolidation — Customer Service / Procurement / Documentation / Sales** 




  





**Company:** 
 Kenshine Group ·
 **Location:** 
 Mumbai, Maharashtra (On\-site) ·
 **Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



  





**About Kenshine Group** 




 Kenshine Group has been moving cargo for Indian exporters and importers since 1989\. We are a multimodal logistics provider and an accredited Authorized Economic Operator (AEO), delivering port\-to\-door, door\-to\-port and door\-to\-door solutions across ocean, air and surface. Our services span freight forwarding, LCL consolidation, customs brokerage, third\-party logistics, warehousing, surface transportation and specialised packing, through Kenshine Global Logistics Private Limited, Kenshine Shipping Private Limited and Kenshine Logistics Private Limited.
 



  





**About the openings** 




 We are expanding our Freight Forwarding and LCL Consolidation business in Mumbai and are hiring across four functions. Candidates at all levels — from freshers to experienced professionals — are encouraged to apply; the role and responsibilities will be matched to your experience.
 



  





**Customer Service** 




 Own a set of accounts end to end: booking confirmations, space planning with carriers and co\-loaders, milestone updates to shippers and consignees, and resolution of delays, roll\-overs and exceptions. You are the single point of contact the customer calls.
 



  





**Procurement** 




 Source and negotiate ocean, air and LCL rates with carriers, NVOCCs, consolidators and overseas agents. Maintain the rate grid, close spot buys against live enquiries, and protect margin on every shipment without compromising transit or reliability.
 



  





**Documentation** 




 Prepare and verify shipping bills, bills of lading, delivery orders, manifests, certificates of origin and export/import documentation. Coordinate filings with customs, carriers and CFS/ICDs, and keep records audit\-ready against AEO and regulatory requirements.
 



  





**Sales** 




 Develop new business among exporters, importers and trade partners in the Mumbai market. Map prospects, quote and convert enquiries, build long\-term account relationships, and work with Procurement and Customer Service to deliver what you sell.
 



  





**What we are looking for** 



* Interest in, or experience with, freight forwarding, LCL consolidation, customs clearance or 3PL operations
* Clear written and spoken English, and the confidence to deal directly with customers, carriers and overseas agents
* Working knowledge of MS Office; familiarity with a logistics or ERP system is an advantage
* Accuracy and attention to detail — in this business, a wrong document number is a real cost
* A graduate degree in any discipline; qualifications in Logistics, Supply Chain, International Trade or Commerce are preferred
* Willingness to work on\-site in Mumbai



  





**Why Kenshine** 



* 35\+ years in the trade, with an established network of carriers and overseas agents
* AEO\-accredited operations and strong compliance standards
* Direct exposure to the full shipment lifecycle rather than one narrow task
* A small, senior team where good work is visible

 Visit Website

**Job Description**
**Mactores** 
 is the agent\-native AWS modernization firm. Most modernization work doesn't ship, it stalls in pilots, slips a year, or lands at three times the budget. We exist to ship it: production systems running, legacy retired, outcomes measured. Our delivery is built on Aedeon, the agent platform built by Mactores' founders' sister company, which absorbs the repetitive 60–70% of engagement work, discovery, dependency mapping, validation, test generation, that traditional consulting bills human hours against. Forward\-deployed engineers own the rest: architecture, judgment, and cutover, on dates we commit to in the contract.
   

  

 As a Partner Solutions Architect, you own that documentation across all of our partnerships, not just AWS. You're given project and architecture details by the delivery team, and you turn them into the competency documentation each partner program requires, and into case studies you can explain and defend to a partner reviewer, to a prospect, to anyone asking "what did Mactores actually ship here."
   

  

 AI tools are fair game for drafting; the bar is on accuracy and whether it holds up under questioning. Do this well, and the natural next step is a presales architect role, taking these case studies and this partner fluency directly into prospect conversations.
   

  

**What you’ll do?**
* Create and maintain competency documentation across all of Mactores' partnerships AWS, Snowflake, Databricks, Anthropic, OpenAI using project and architecture details provided by the delivery team.
* Produce the technical validation write\-ups, architecture diagrams, and case study documentation each partner's competency and service delivery program requires.
* Build a working command of Mactores' case studies well enough to explain them clearly the problem, the architecture, the outcome to partner reviewers, prospects, or internal stakeholders.
* Use AI tools to accelerate drafting, while owning the accuracy and review\-readiness of the final document.
* Keep documentation format and quality consistent across partners and engagements.
* Flag gaps in the project details you're given when they're not sufficient to produce audit\-ready documentation.
* Work against fixed deadlines tied to partner program renewal and review cycles.


**What we’re looking for?**
* 2–3 years of experience in technical documentation, solutions architecture, or a related role touching AWS and/or modern data/AI platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, Anthropic, OpenAI).
* Working knowledge of cloud architecture concepts enough to read a design across different platforms and document it accurately.
* Strong technical writing skills; comfortable turning raw project detail into a document that reads cleanly to an external reviewer.
* Comfortable explaining technical case studies out loud, not just writing them this role grows toward customer\-facing work.
* Familiarity with diagramming tools (draw.io, Lucidchart, or similar) for architecture diagrams.
* Comfortable using AI tools as part of a documentation workflow, without leaning on them for accuracy you haven't verified.
* Detail\-oriented, organized, and able to hold a deadline without supervision.

The role will develop and review OT network architectures, segmentation models, connectivity designs, and integration solutions supporting SCADA, PLC, DCS, telemetry, autonomous systems, mobile fleet communications, and production\-critical digital platforms across greenfield and brownfield projects. The ideal candidate will bring strong OT networking experience, practical understanding of industrial communications and cybersecurity\-by\-design, and the ability to work collaboratively across engineering, cybersecurity, telecommunications, vendor, and client teams.


**Key Accountabilities**
* Develop OT network architectures across industrial control, telecommunications, edge, integration, and cybersecurity domains, ensuring alignment with client requirements, operational objectives, and project delivery phases.
* Develop OT network standards and requirements documentation in collaboration with client OT systems stakeholders to achieve client capability objectives.
* Produce engineering artefacts including OT network architecture diagrams, network segmentation models, connectivity drawings, interface specifications, IP addressing strategies, firewall zoning concepts, routing concepts, wireless backhaul integration views, and implementation\-ready design inputs.
* Design and review OT network infrastructure supporting SCADA, PLCs, DCS, telemetry, industrial applications, remote operations, mobile fleet systems, and autonomous mining systems.
* Provide technical input into IT/OT convergence strategies, including segmentation, secure connectivity, edge\-to\-cloud integration, and operational data transport across levels 1\-4\.
* Apply OT cybersecurity\-by\-design principles, including network segmentation, defence\-in\-depth, Zero Trust concepts, microsegmentation, secure remote access, and controlled integration between OT and enterprise networks.
* Ensure OT network designs consider relevant standards and frameworks, including IEC 62443, ISO 27001, NIST CSF, SOCI Act obligations where applicable, ISA\-95 concepts, secure industrial protocols, and client\-specific engineering standards.
* Support the selection, assessment, and integration of network equipment, industrial switches, routers, wireless systems, firewalls, gateways, network management platforms, and OT monitoring tools.
* Review vendor, subcontractor, and system integrator designs for compliance with engineering principles, client standards, project specifications, constructability, maintainability, and cybersecurity requirements.
* Coordinate with cybersecurity, control systems, telecommunications, electrical, digital, and operations teams to ensure OT network designs support safety, reliability, operational continuity, maintainability, and future scalability.


**Additional Responsibilities**
* Support vulnerability assessment, risk assessment, threat modelling, and network hardening activities where they relate to OT network design and integration.
* Provide technical input to FEED studies, concept studies, design reviews, procurement packages, RFP/RFQ responses, tender submissions, and project estimates.
* Support construction, commissioning, and handover teams by providing technical clarification, design intent verification, non\-conformance review support, and field engineering input.
* Maintain compliance with relevant health, safety, environmental, quality, and cybersecurity legislative requirements across OT networking activities.


**Job Specific Skills**
* Strong practical knowledge of OT networking technologies, including industrial Ethernet, VLANs, routing, switching, firewalls, network segmentation, SDN, SD\-WAN, MPLS, secure remote access, and IT/OT convergence.
* Experience designing networks for industrial automation and control systems, including connectivity for SCADA, PLCs, DCS, telemetry, historians, edge systems, wireless networks, and production\-critical services.
* Strong understanding of industrial protocols and integration patterns, including Modbus, Profibus, EtherCAT, OPC, DNP3, OPC UA, MQTT, API\-based integration, and secure data exchange between OT and IT systems.
* Working knowledge of RF and telecommunications systems used in mining and industrial operations, including LTE/5G, Wi\-Fi, microwave backhaul, point\-to\-point radio, fibre backhaul, and communications infrastructure.
* Ability to produce clear network design documentation, including architecture views, design reports, technical assessments, network interface definitions, and implementation\-supporting design packages.
* Experience working within multidisciplinary engineering teams and coordinating inputs from OT, IT, cybersecurity, digital, telecommunications, project delivery, vendor, and client stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of OT cybersecurity principles, including segmentation, access control, monitoring, anomaly detection, patching considerations, and secure design of critical infrastructure environments.
* Ability to contribute to cost\-benefit analysis, transition planning, FEED handover, procurement alignment, and project risk review.


**About You**
 To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:
   

  

**Essential**
* Bachelor degree in Electrical Engineering, Communications Engineering, Computer Science, Systems Engineering, Control Systems, or a related discipline.
* 10\-15 years of relevant experience in OT networking, industrial communications, control systems networks, telecommunications, or IT/OT integration within mining, resources, oil and gas, utilities, or industrial environments.
* Experience across the engineering design lifecycle, ideally from concept or FEED through detailed design, implementation support, commissioning, and handover.
* Demonstrated experience in engineering design of greenfield and brownfield industrial projects involving OT systems, ICS, SCADA, communications, or production\-critical networks.
* Knowledge of industrial control environments, including SCADA platforms, PLCs, DCS, industrial networks, and critical communications systems.
* Demonstrated ability to review vendor and subcontractor designs for compliance with client specifications, engineering principles, standards, and project requirements.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical concepts to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.


**Preferred**
* Certifications such as CCNP, CCIE, CompTIA Network\+, IEC 62443 Foundation/Practitioner, CISSP, GICSP, TOGAF, SABSA, Azure/AWS networking or solutions architecture, or equivalent practical credentials.
* Experience with network monitoring, OT monitoring, SIEM integration, anomaly detection, asset visibility, and security operations interfaces.
* Exposure to architecture modelling and requirements traceability tools such as Orbus Infinity, ArchiMate, or equivalent tools.
* Experience with mining communications, autonomous fleet connectivity, mobile fleet systems, LTE/5G, Wi\-Fi, microwave backhaul, and fibre\-based backhaul networks.
* Experience with industrial OT network equipment deployed in underground mining operational areas or similar harsh environments (heat and contaminants).


**Other Attributes**
* Highly organised, reliable, practical, and delivery\-focused.
* Able to work under pressure, manage competing priorities, and maintain accuracy and attention to detail in operationally critical environments.
* Strong relationship\-building skills with clients, vendors, peers, senior management, and multidisciplinary project teams.
* Able to protect sensitive, proprietary, and security\-related information.
* Proactive, service\-minded, collaborative, and willing to challenge assumptions constructively to improve technical outcomes.
* Committed to quality, safety, operational reliability, and Worley values.


**Moving forward together**
 We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values\-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation.
   

  

 We’re building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.
   

  

 And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology.
   

  

 Whatever your ambition, there’s a path for you here. And there’s no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.
   

  

 Worley takes personal data protection seriously and respects EU and local data protection laws. You can read our full Recruitment Privacy Notice Here.
   

  

 Please note: If you are being represented by a recruitment agency you will not be considered, to be considered you will need to apply directly to Worley.

title: Manager, Enterprise Partnership
description:
**About the Role** 




  





 Razorpay Ads is building a commerce media and audience intelligence business powered by Razorpay’s transaction ecosystem. We are looking for a
 **Manager – Agency Sales** 
 to build and scale our relationships with leading media agencies, digital agencies, agency trading teams, and their advertiser portfolios.
 



 This is a high\-ownership role at the intersection of
 **advertising, data, commerce and fintech** 
 . You will be responsible for making Razorpay Ads a strategic partner for agencies — helping them leverage Razorpay’s audience intelligence and media capabilities to solve advertiser objectives across performance, customer acquisition, brand building, audience targeting and measurement.
 



 The role goes beyond selling individual campaigns. You will own agency relationships, develop advertiser pipelines within agency portfolios, unlock briefs and budgets, and build a repeatable agency\-led revenue engine for Razorpay Ads.
 



  





**What You’ll Own** 




**Agency Relationship \& Business Development** 



* Build and own strategic relationships across leading agency networks, independent agencies and digital/performance agencies.
* Develop strong relationships with senior stakeholders across
 **agency leadership, investment, planning, strategy, digital, performance and account management teams** 
 .
* Establish Razorpay Ads as a preferred partner for data\-led, commerce\-media and performance advertising solutions.
* Create agency\-level account plans covering priority agencies, key stakeholders, advertiser portfolios, opportunities and revenue potential.
* Drive regular agency engagements, capability sessions, workshops and joint client conversations.



**Advertiser \& Revenue Development** 



* Identify high\-potential advertisers within agency portfolios and build a structured pipeline of briefs and opportunities.
* Work with agency teams to understand advertiser objectives, media plans, campaign challenges and investment priorities.
* Convert agency relationships into
 **active advertisers, repeat advertisers and scalable revenue opportunities** 
 .
* Own the sales cycle from prospecting and solutioning through proposal, commercial negotiation, campaign closure and renewal.
* Drive penetration across priority categories including
 **BFSI, fintech, D2C, e\-commerce, travel, consumer internet, auto and other digitally intensive categories** 
 .
* Build quarterly and annual agency revenue plans and maintain strong visibility on pipeline, closures and forecasts.



**Consultative \& Solution Selling** 



* Translate advertiser and agency briefs into solutions using Razorpay Ads’ media, audience and data capabilities.
* Position Razorpay’s transaction\-led audience intelligence as a differentiated alternative or complement to conventional digital targeting signals.
* Develop solutions spanning
 **audience intelligence, transaction\-led targeting, onsite/offsite media, performance campaigns, brand campaigns and measurement** 
 .
* Build compelling narratives and proposals that connect Razorpay’s capabilities to measurable advertiser outcomes.
* Partner with agencies to create customized solutions rather than relying on standardized inventory\-led selling.



**Agency GTM** 



* Build a structured GTM strategy for priority agency groups and their advertiser portfolios.
* Map agency stakeholders, key accounts, upcoming pitches, annual planning cycles and seasonal/festive opportunities.
* Identify opportunities for agency\-level partnerships, preferred partner programs, joint pitches and advertiser workshops.
* Develop repeatable playbooks for converting agency relationships into briefs, campaigns and recurring advertiser investments.
* Represent Razorpay Ads at relevant agency forums, industry conversations and advertiser engagements.



**Campaign Success \& Account Growth** 



* Partner closely with Campaign Management, Product and Operations teams to ensure campaigns deliver against advertiser objectives.
* Stay engaged beyond campaign closure to ensure strong advertiser and agency experience.
* Use campaign results and insights to drive renewals, upsells and larger annual commitments.
* Identify opportunities to expand successful campaigns across brands, categories and agency teams.
* Build case studies and proof points that can accelerate adoption across the wider agency ecosystem.



**Market Intelligence \& Product Feedback** 



* Maintain a strong understanding of the Indian digital advertising ecosystem, agency structures, advertiser budgets and emerging media trends.
* Track competitive offerings across ad networks, commerce media, retail media, audience platforms and large digital publishers.
* Bring structured agency and advertiser feedback to Product, Strategy and Campaign teams.
* Help shape Razorpay Ads’ positioning, packaging, pricing and product roadmap based on market demand.



  





**What Success Looks Like** 




 Success in this role will be measured primarily through:
 



**Agency penetration:** 
 Depth and quality of relationships across priority agencies and senior agency stakeholders.
 



**Active advertisers:** 
 Number of advertisers activated through the agency ecosystem.
 



**Quality advertisers:** 
 Ability to acquire strategic advertisers with meaningful and scalable budget potential.
 



**Advertiser retention:** 
 Repeat campaigns and continued investment from activated advertisers.
 



**Pipeline creation:** 
 Strength and quality of advertiser briefs and qualified opportunities generated through agencies.
 



**Revenue:** 
 Achievement of quarterly and annual revenue objectives.
 



**Strategic relationships:** 
 Ability to convert transactional agency relationships into long\-term partnerships.
 



  





**What We’re Looking For** 



* **5–8 years of experience** 
 in agency sales, digital advertising, media sales, adtech, commerce media, publisher sales or related businesses.
* Strong existing relationships across
 **media agencies, digital agencies and/or performance agencies** 
 in India.
* Demonstrated experience selling digital advertising solutions through agencies and influencing advertiser budgets.
* Strong understanding of the digital advertising ecosystem including
 **Meta, Google, programmatic, publisher media, performance marketing and brand advertising** 
 .
* Ability to engage comfortably with stakeholders ranging from agency planners and account leads to Business Heads, Managing Partners and CXOs.
* Strong consultative selling and solutioning capabilities — able to start with a client problem rather than an inventory proposition.
* Strong commercial orientation with experience owning pipelines, negotiations and revenue targets.
* Good understanding of advertising metrics including CPM, CPC, CTR, CPL, CPA, ROAS, reach, frequency and brand/measurement metrics.
* Ability to interpret campaign performance and convert results into a compelling growth narrative.
* Strong presentation, communication and negotiation skills.
* High ownership, bias for action and comfort operating in an early\-stage business where GTM playbooks are still being built.



  





**Strong Plus** 



* Experience working at an
 **ad network, large digital publisher, commerce/retail media network, DSP, adtech platform or agency partnership function** 
 .
* Existing relationships across leading agency networks and independent digital agencies.
* Experience selling to BFSI, fintech, D2C, e\-commerce or consumer internet advertisers.
* Experience selling both
 **performance and branding solutions** 
 .
* Exposure to first\-party data, audience intelligence, CDPs, clean rooms, retail/commerce media or transaction\-led advertising.
* Experience building a new agency channel or GTM motion from an early stage.



  





**The Person We’d Like to Hire** 




 We are looking for someone who is
 **well\-networked but not dependent on their network; commercially aggressive but consultative in approach; comfortable selling what exists today while helping shape what needs to be built tomorrow** 
 .
 



 The ideal candidate understands how agencies operate, knows how budgets and briefs move through the ecosystem, can open senior\-level conversations, and has the persistence and strategic thinking required to turn those relationships into a sustainable revenue engine for Razorpay Ads.

 MSCI Global Index Client Service is the primary point of contact for clients and users of MSCI Index products and serves as the key link to MSCI's Global Research and Index operations. The team members are responsible for directly responding to a wide variety of methodology, usage, interpretational and technical questions on MSCI benchmark products.

 This position is specifically for SAP OData and Gateway development. The consultant is expected to design, build and support the OData services that power SAP Fiori applications and external integrations, and to own troubleshooting across the user interface, Gateway and backend layers.
   

  

**Key Skills**

* Implementing service logic in the data provider class for read, create, update, delete and query operations.

* Error handling and returning meaningful messages to the Fiori user interface.
* Authorisation checks within the service and secure handling of create and update calls.
* Troubleshooting end to end across the Fiori user interface, Gateway and backend using the Gateway error log.

* Debugging, code optimisation and performance tuning.
* SAP development standards, unit testing, code review and transport management.
* Good understanding of code pushdown and how to write database\-efficient ABAP on SAP HANA.
* ABAP Development Tools (Eclipse) along with SAP GUI \- optional.


**Good to Have**
* Deep insert, function imports and batch processing.
* Hub versus embedded Gateway deployment.
* SAP Fiori / SAPUI5 awareness for end\-to\-end troubleshooting.
* OData V4 and the ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model (RAP).
* SAP certification in ABAP or ABAP on HANA.


**Key Responsibilities**

* Support the full project lifecycle including implementation and support.

 Mirah Hospitality is a leading food and beverage group in India with nearly 25 years of experience in building iconic hospitality brands. The company is home to popular concepts such as Hitchki, Bayroute, and Rajdhani, all known for strong brand identity and consistent guest experiences. With a presence across 30\+ outlets, Mirah operates scalable business models designed for sustainable growth in the food and nightlife sector.  The Tender Executive \- Churchgate will manage end\-to\-end tender processes for Mirah Hospitality’s projects and services. * Ability to work collaboratively with cross\-functional teams and maintain accurate records and reports.

title: MEP Estimation Manager
description:
**Job Requirements**
**MEP Estimation Manager \| Mumbai, India**
**Function / Department**
 Estimation
   

  

**Grade / Level**
 L2
   

  

**Reports To**
 Head of Estimation
   

  

**Location / Base**
 Mumbai, India
   

  

**Employment Type**
 Permanent
   

  

**Mobilization Window**
**Travel**
 Frequent regional travel — OEM meetings and pre\-bid visits
   

  

**1\- Purpose Of The Role (Job Summary)**
 Lead mechanical, electrical, and ELV estimation for data center EPC bids. MEP is 60–70% of contract value, so this role drives both bid competitiveness and margin, including OEM pricing strategy for long\-lead plant.
   

  

**2\- Key Responsibilities And Accountabilities**
* Own the complete MEP estimate per tender: equipment, installation, subcontracts, commissioning support, and spares.
* Direct the discipline estimators to one estimate basis, boundary matrix, and assumptions log.
* Drive OEM budget pricing for long\-lead equipment — generators, UPS, switchgear, transformers, chillers, CRAH/CRAC/fan\-walls, busway — including delivery and escalation terms.
* Read tender documents for DC\-specific drivers: redundancy topology (N\+1/2N), tier requirements, liquid cooling, EPMS/BMS scope, and phased fit\-out.
* Adjudicate MEP subcontractor quotes and normalize supply, installation, and commissioning splits.
* Maintain MEP benchmarks: cost/MW by topology and geography, cost per kW by system, and installation norms.
* Prepare MEP risk registers, exclusions, and contingency recommendations.
* Lead MEP value engineering with design; quantify alternates for topology, plant selection, and phasing.
* Hand as\-sold estimates to delivery, then reconcile against actuals and update norms.


**3\- Key Performance Indicators**
* As\-sold vs final MEP cost variance within ±5%.
* At least 2 compliant OEM quotes per critical equipment class.
* 100% on\-time MEP estimate delivery per bid plan.
* Benchmark database refreshed quarterly.
* Value\-engineering savings identified and accepted per bid.


**4\- Qualifications \& Certifications**
* Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering (mandatory).
* CDCP preferred; CDCS, PMP, or Uptime ATD an advantage.


**5\- Experience**
* 07\-10 years in MEP estimation for EPC and construction, including 6\+ years on data center facilities.
* Priced complete MEP scopes, with direct OEM negotiation on critical power and cooling plant.
* International or GCC pricing exposure is an advantage.


**6\- Competencies**
* Deep cost fluency across DC power and cooling chains.
* Strong OEM and subcontractor network.
* Structured estimate governance — one basis, no orphan assumptions.
* Commercially sharp on exclusions, escalation, and risk pricing.
* Leads distributed estimator teams to deadline.
* Leadership, Analytical Thinking


**Work Experience**
**7\- Technical Skills**
 MEP cost estimation, BOQ preparation, HVAC and electrical systems, vendor quote adjudication, cost planning, and Excel.
   

  

**8\- Key Interfaces**
* Internal: Proposal/Tender Manager, CSA Estimation Manager, discipline estimators, Design \& Engineering (MEP), SCM, Finance \& Commercial.
* External: OEMs (gensets, UPS, chillers, switchgear, busway), MEP subcontractors, client and PMC counterparts.


**9\- Special Conditions**
 Heavy coordination across multiple MEP disciplines under bid deadlines.
